purpose: Two debris pairs either side of the 5 km threshold: 4.7 km (flagged, low) and 5.3 km (not flagged). Same-altitude pairs meet again half an orbit (~50 min) later at a drifted miss that can fall under 5 km, so the designed passes are 5 minutes apart and this scenario's case uses a short window (00:40-01:16Z) that excludes the re-encounters.
